stock_config.resolved_kernels: triangle attention: cuEquivariance (cuequivariance_ops_torch triangle_attention); triangle multiplicative update: cuEquivariance triangle_multiplicative_update; everything else upstream's shipped path (Triton fused softmax/linear where upstream uses it); DeepSpeed DS4Sci evoformer attention OFF — read per run from <output>/model_config.json, upstream precedence attention cuEq > DS4Sci > Triton > torch (core/model/primitives/attention.py:433-467), trimul cuEq > Triton-fused > torch (core/model/layers/triangular_multiplicative_update.py:1124-1169)
stock_config.chunk_plan: pair-stack chunking pinned: tune_chunk_size false, chunk_size 1024 (upstream's autotuner's own choice on an 80 GB H100 at every ChunkSizeTuner instance for 400-2000-token inputs); the `default` arm (the bare shipped command) keeps the autotuner
stock_config.det_sets: the same file; `--det 1` adds, INSIDE the stock process through the det site (opt_core.precision.det_site, the one PYTHONPATH exception the ENV-CLEAN proof names): torch.use_deterministic_algorithms(True), cudnn deterministic / benchmark off, CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=:4096:8; upstream's seed as given (default 42). Bitwise run-to-run reproducible within and across H100 hosts at level 1 (structures + confidences); level 0 is not; a configuration with use_deepspeed_evo_attention on is NOT reproducible at level 1
stock_config.reason: the fastest correct configuration upstream 0.5.0's own runner-yaml keys reach on H100: steady-state `Model forward time` 0.83 / 0.77 / 0.69 / 0.64 of the shipped configuration (Triton kernels, 32-true) at 400 / 800 / 1200 / 2000 tokens, bracketed fresh-process measurement; DS4Sci ties the shipped configuration and is not deterministic; kernels-off is 1.2-1.6x slower at 2-3x the memory
stock_config.templates: upstream 0.5.0 consumes templates on the stock route (template_preprocessor_settings {structure_directory, structure_file_format: cif, fetch_missing_structures: false} in the runner yaml; per-chain template keys in the query JSON). A templated input passes its template keys with --use-templates true; an UNTEMPLATED arm must STRIP the template keys from the query JSON — `--use-templates false` with template keys present fails inside upstream (the .a3m path is read as a preprocessed pickle: UnpicklingError)

stock_environment.note: every must_be_absent entry is a name prefix: the add-ons' switch families (OF3_*, OF3T_*, OF3O_*, OF3TP_*, BFTP_*, ROWPAIR_*, FPF_TRIMUL_V4_* — the names this tree's units read), the package switch families (OPENFOLD3_OPT*, OPENFOLD3_OB0_OPT*), the deterministic-recipe workspace variable (exported by the recipe itself under --det 1, allowed under the stock proof's det exception only), CUDA MPS and the DS4Sci CUTLASS override; a stock process carries none of them and no add-on directory on PYTHONPATH. upstream_reads are upstream 0.5.0's OWN switches that happen to sit under the OF3_ prefix: stock's surface — passed to the stock child unchanged, recorded in the proof, never refused. reads are recorded in the proof when present.
